title: Leftover Tokens After _addLiquidity Not Returned
description: The `_addLiquidity()` function uses the minimum of both token amounts to add balanced liquidity to the V4 pool. Any excess tokens from the larger amount are left in the contract without being tracked or returned to depositors.
impact: Value leakage over time as tokens accumulate in the contract without tracking. Depositors lose the value of excess tokens that remain stuck in the contract.
attackPath: Excess tokens from one side remain in contract
These tokens are not tracked or attributed to anyone
Value accumulates in contract, effectively lost to depositors
codeSnippet: // _addLiquidity() uses minimum of both amounts, leaving excess untracked
recommendation: Track leftover tokens and include them in value calculations, or refund excess tokens to depositors after liquidity addition.
